author: HP_Superman101
body: Hi my name is HP_Superman101 and i got banned. I got banned for excessive infractions. I deeply apologize for doing what I did. I just hope you guys can give me a second chance by unbanning me. Please i promise to behave on my second chance. I really love to play on your server and since i got banned I haven't played in 5 months. i really hope you guys consider unbanning me. Thanks.
